description: Recent crypto news for up to 25 coins, linked to each coin by CoinRithm's curated coin-news graph. Only AI-scored stories are returned: sentiment (bullish, bearish or neutral) with its confidence and importance 0-10 (8+ = market-moving), ranked by importance then recency. ageMinutes is each story's age. Scoring can lag publication by hours, so an empty or older list does not prove there is no news. Needs an API key with read scope.

agentTrace.description: Optional private trace metadata stored in the caller's ledger.

decisionId.description: Agent decision id for quote/write attribution.

rationaleSummary.description: Optional concise rationale summary. Do not include chain-of-thought, secrets, or account identity.

strategyLabel.description: Short strategy label, self-reported by the caller.

minImportance.description: Only stories at or above this importance (default 0).

name: get_news
title: Get scored crypto news
